## 🔧 Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Set up GitHub token
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env and add your GITHUB_TOKEN

# Run locally (dry run)
npm test

# Run and update
npm start
```

## 🔧 Technical Details

- **API**: GitHub GraphQL API
- **Schedule**: Every 24 hours via GitHub Actions
- **No Database**: Purely static, no backend required
